book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Luka

content: Yecho iyoka
Lichiko lya jumapile, putiputi akakeghe bhajhakughegha mahuta ghighanungila petelele ghibhakalenganikiye na kujhenda nagho ku mambe.
Bhajhakulikolela lighanga lela lya kuyekelela mambe libhilimbiwe kuupele jha mambe.
Nambo pubhajhingila nkate mu mambe, bhakaiwe ndeka yegha jha Bhambo Yecho.
Pubhajhendilila kukangacha nhwalo gwa kilebhe chenie, pahina jhabhe papa bhakajhemite bhando bhabhele bhibhawalalii ngobho nhuo ya mbuu.
Akakeghe bhala bhajhakutumbula kulendema, bhajhakulita pahe. Peniya bhando bhala pubhalongila, “Nhwalo gwa nike mipalaha jwabhii na ughome pakate jha bhubhawile?
Abhii jhe pambano, ayokite! Nkomboke channobholila pakibha amela ku Galilaya.
‘Mwana gwa Mundo nakamulwa na bhando bhibhabhii na uhakaho, na bhene nabhamamba pa nchalaba na lichiko lyutato nayoka.’ ”
Peniya, ndi akakeghe bhala pibhakombwika malobhe ghalongila Yecho,
pubhabhujhita kuhumii ku mambe, bhajhakulonge mambu ghanga ghoha ghughapitile kwa bhabholwa bhake kome na jhumo bha Yecho na bhando bhange.
Akakeghe bhubhahikita kulonge gheniya kwa akatenga, akibha Maliya jwahumila ku kilambo chaku Magidala na Yoane na Maliya majhe mundo Yakobu, pamonga na akakeghe bhange bhubhakalongohine nabho.
Nambo bhabholwa bhala bhajhakughapucha malobhe. Bhahe, bhakajheketile jhe.
Nambo Petile akajhenda mbelo ade ku mambe. Ajhakulita kulingukiya nkate, ajhakubhona nga ngobho jha malelo tugha. Peniya ngabhujhita ukajha kongo abhii hechu kwa gheniya ghughapitile.
Mwanja gwa kujhenda ku Emau
Lichiko lele, bhabholwa bhabhele bha Yecho bhakibha mu kutyanga bhajhawila kuchenda jhimo jhikemwa ku Emau chikibhii utale kilomita kome na jhimo kuhumii ku Yeluchalemo.
Bhakibha na malongeche gha ilebhe yoha itendike.
Pubhajhendilila na malongeche ghabhe na kukikonya, Yecho jwenio ndi pabhandikila na kulongohana nabho pamonga.
Bhene bhakamwene kwa miho ghabhe, nambo bhakaumanyite jhe.
Yecho ajhakwakonya, “Mangota milongolelana nike, kongo mmii mu kutyanga?” Na bhene bhajhakujhema, kumiho jhabhe kujhakungamala kwa ungolongonde.
Mundo jhumo pakate jhabhe, liina lyake Kiliopa, ajhakunyangula, “Bho, mwe maghene kanjika chino pa muche gwa ku Yeluchalemo, umanyite ndeka ilebhe itendike machiko gha pahina ghano?”

Jwenio ngakonyita, “Ilebhe ghane kabhele?” Na bhene ngabhajhangwila, “Ilebhe ipambalikine Yecho jwa ku Nachalete. Mundo jwenio akibha nnondole jhuna likakala lya kuhenga na kubhola palonge jha Chapanga na kwa bhando bhoha.
Akapiya matambiko na ilongoche hito bhajhakukamua kwa bhakolo bhu ku Loma bhahadabwii akomwe, na bhene bhajhakumamba panchalaba.
Nambo twenga tukahobholile jwenio ndi jwa kuhighombola Ichilahele! Kuchocha kwa gheniya deleno ndi lichiko lyutato kuhumii pubhatehila ilebhe yenio.
Helahela akakeghe bhange kuhumii pakate jhito bhajhakutukangacha. Putiputi bhajhakujhenda ku mambe,
nambo bhakaikoli ndeka yegha jha Yecho. Bhajhakukelebhuka na kutulongelela bhapitilwe na akatumiche bha kunane kwa Chapanga, alongila Yecho abhii ghome.
Bhajhito bhange bhakajhenda ku mambe bhajhakulola ghala ghighalongilwa na akakeghe, nambo jwenio bhakamwe ndeka.”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Mangota mwenga mupumbumwike naha! Mijheketela kachoko kachoko ghoha ghighalongoleka na milondole bha Chapanga!
Bho, ikampala ndeka Kilichitu kubhehe mulung'ahe, na peniya ndi ajhingila mu ukolo gwake?”

Bhahe, peniya ndi pajhendilila kwachimulila mbone mambu ghoha gwa jwenio hotuhotu ghughabhii mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga, kutumbulila itabo ijhandikwe na Mucha ade mu itabo henge ya milondole bha Chapanga.
Pubhabhandikila kuhika pa chenda jhene, Yecho ajhakutenda anda atenda kupetelecha.
Nambo bhene bhajhakupembelekeya chonde, “Uhighalike pamonga na twenga, nhwalo lyobha litipike na lubhendo lutumbwile.” Ajhakujhenda nkate na kutama.
Patamita pahe na kulye nabho, ajhakutola libumunda na kunchenguu Chapanga, na kuumetula na kwapekeya ajhake.
Papalapala miho ghabhe ghajhakudindulilwa, bhajhakumanya, nambo jwenio ajhakwaghala pakate jhabhe.
Bhahe, bhajhakukonyana, “Bho, miojho jhito ikananamwike jhe pakibha achimulila mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga mundela mola?”
Papalapala bhajhakubhoka na kubhujha ku Yeluchalemo. Bhajhakwakolela bhabholwa kome na jhumo bha Yecho na bhando bhange bhibhakibha pamonga na bhene.
Bhalongila, “Chakaka Bhambo ayokite! Akongine na Simone!”
Bhahe, bhando bhala bhabhele bhajhakulonge ilebhe ipitile undela, na pubhamanyita Yecho pametwila libumunda.
Yecho abhapitila bhabholwa bhake
Pubhakibha mukulonge gheniya, Yecho jwenio akajhemite pakate jhabhe na kwalobholela, “Ntamengane kwa uteeke.”
Bhene bhajhakuchituka hake na kujhoghopa bhahambwika pange bhalihwene lihoka.
Nambo Yecho ngalongila, “Nhwalo gwa nike mijhoghopa? Nhwalo gwa nike mme na kiholo kumwojho gwino?
Nninge mabhanga gha mu mabhoko ghango na mabhanga gha mu makongono ghango, naumanya kubhehe ndi nenga. Umbapahe mmone, nhwalo lihoka likwetejhe yegha hilu mihupa ngita chiunolekeya.”
Pajhomolila kulonge naha, ajhakwalangiya mabhanga gha mu mabhoko pamonga na mabhanga gha mu makongono ghake.
Pubhakibha bhamela nakujheketela nhwalo gwa mukuhangana na kukangacha kwabhe. Yecho pakonyita, “Bho, kibhii chakulyegha pambano?”
Bhahe, bhajhakupekeha kimbembela chuluhomba lubhatutwihe.
Ajhakutola na kulyegha, kongo bhoha bhabhii kulola.

Peniya ajhakwalobholela, “Ghangano ndi mambu ghininongolila punikibha na mangota: Imbalita kutimila ghala ghoha ghighajhandikwe kwa nenga mu lilaghalikilo lya Mucha, na mu itabo ya milondole bha Chapanga, na Zabule.”
Bhahe, ajhakwatenda malango ghabhe ghahoto kumanya mbone Majhandiko gha Chapanga.
Ajhakwalobholela, “Ijhandikwe naha, Kilichitu Nkomboche natendwa kung'ahichwa na pa lichiko lya utato nayoka.
Kwa liina lyake, ilambo yoha kutumbulila ku Yeluchalemo itangachilwe kubhehe bhando bhipalwa kuleka na kulekekewa uhakaho.
Mangota mipalwa kwalobholela bhando kubhehe mambu ghanga ndi uchakaka.
Namwete naninetelangana jhola Tate gwango jhalaghalikiye kuntuma. Nambo uhighalike pa muche ade papala kumpekehe likakala kuhumii kunane kwa Chapanga.”
Yecho ibhujha kunane kwa Chapanga
Peniya Yecho pabhalongwicha bhabholwa bhake kuhumii ku Yeluchalemo ade ku Betaniya, ajhakujhinula mabhoko ghake na kwape mota.
Pakibha mu kwape mota, ajhakwaleka, ajhakutolwa kujhenda kunane kwa Chapanga.
Bhene bhajhakunyinamila, kabhele bhajhakukelebhuka ku Yeluchalemo, kongo bhabhii mu kuhangana hake.
Helahela bhajhendilila kupipikiya pa Nyumba jha Chapanga, kongo bhannombita Chapanga.
